claims.value: Granite-3B-Code-Base-128K extends the context length of Granite-3B-Code-Base from 2K to 128K with continual pretraining. It is a 3B parameter model trained on code data from 116 programming languages, intended for enterprise software engineering tasks like code generation, explanation, and fixing. The model is marked as deprecated for new projects in favor of newer Granite models.
